page.notes: Note h and note i are placed by their reference marks in the text. Note i reads "In Tom. Concil. Volum.2" with the 2 printed as a superscript. Doubtful readings: "Agathensem" (the mark over the A is uncertain), "Quęso" (the ę is uncertain), and "secundū" (the first letter is printed in a form that could also be f).
